title: AI领域今日结构性变化分析
core_insight: 今日新增信息显示，AI领域在技术层面、基础设施、应用层、资本信号和风险信号等多个维度都有明显变化，尤其是在LLM、自我改进AI和AI应用于各行业等方面

dimension_texts.technology: LLM能力边界被推进，出现新的范式 自我改进AI和LLM的新应用 A Long-Run Persistence Theory for AI Systems under the Redundancy-Adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS) The RAIL Principles for Neurosymbolic AI: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 推理成本出现变化，新硬件发布 芯片/算力趋势分析，云厂商定价 Recurrent Residual Quantization: A Progressive Multi-Precision Representation for LLMs Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
dimension_texts.application: AI进入了新行业或新场景，例如智能音箱和matchmaking 替代旧的解决方案，例如传统SaaS被AI-native产品替代 OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400 Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
dimension_texts.capital: 融资方向出现集中趋势，某细分赛道密集融资 估值水平有何变化 大厂战略投资/收购有何动向 Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
